name: A Coruña
discoveryMethod: Separate official English and Spanish/Galician discovery, followed by direct inspection of the Concello da Coruña ArcGIS REST layer metadata and bounded anonymous GeoJSON queries.
queryOutcomes: Both discovery routes found Spain's official Catastro portal and Galicia/Concello map routes. The local Concello service is a genuine polygon feature layer, but its official description limits it to publicly owned/public-administration parcels. Three safe-ID polygons were retained; no claim of citywide or private-parcel coverage is made.

attempts.query: A Coruña official cadastral map parcels Xunta Galicia catastro visor
attempts.outcome: Found official Xunta Galicia, Spanish Catastro, and Concello da Coruña routes.

attempts.query: visor cartográfico parcelas A Coruña catastro oficial
attempts.outcome: Found official Galicia parcel viewer and municipal public-parcels service.
Polygon layer metadata loaded; service CRS EPSG:25829; native safe candidate refcat observed.
Three polygon features returned; server reported exceededTransferLimit=true. Unsafe source properties were discarded from retained sample.
Zero features at exact WUP point in the public-only layer; not interpreted as citywide absence.

sourceAssessment.localCustodian: Concello da Coruña official GIS is evidenced as a local municipal source for public cadastral parcels; the Spanish Dirección General del Catastro is the national cadastral custodian evidenced by its official portal.
sourceAssessment.publicService: https://ide.coruna.gal/server/rest/services/Intranet/PARCELAS_CATASTRALES/MapServer/2 exposes anonymous ArcGIS JSON/GeoJSON polygon queries.
sourceAssessment.scope: Publicly owned/public-administration parcels only; not proven complete cadastral coverage.

scopeLimits: The service description limits the layer to public parcels and the response was intentionally bounded to three features.
The exact WUP point returned no feature in this layer; no coordinate adjustment was made.
The query response reported exceededTransferLimit=true, so it is not a citywide extract.
No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS exception was used.
No citywide absence inference is made from the point result or layer scope.
No source integration/admission or runtime qualification is implied by this packet.
uncertainty: Public municipal polygon access and native refcat identity are verified, but complete cadastral coverage, private parcel access, pagination/completeness, and adapter qualification remain unknown.
pointBasis: Immutable WUP queue point; retained exactly and not shifted to seek a parcel hit.
